summary: OneMedNet Corp filed an 8-K announcing the scheduling of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders for September 18, 2026, with a record date of August 11, 2026. The filing updates the deadlines for stockholder nominations and proposals due to the meeting date being changed by more than 30 days from the 2025 annual meeting anniversary. Stockholder proposals for inclusion in proxy materials must be received by August 5, 2026. This is a routine procedural filing to establish meeting dates and deadlines, not a special situation event.
